objective: BUKLOD Empire Arena premium native gameplay HUD, readable Genesis map graphics and 13 canon-identity actor visual feedback with customizable, ergonomically arranged round touch controls, bounded zoom, safe scene layout and per-device controller preferences. Offline staging practice only. Add a fully playable, best-of-three, disconnected solo duel against real local CPU opponents selectable from the 13 canonical heroes, with difficulty, round scoring, equivalent level-6 match-only abilities and no ranked/reward impact. Sound and graphics completeness: real event-to-audio mappings for ally/enemy hero kills, tower/seal/building damage, farming by material, buff wildlife, inventory pickup/use, construction completion and upgrades; implement 2.5D state-driven resource/loot/buff/structure graphics while verifying all local hero poses and scene art. Action-specific weapon slashes, real victim hit reaction, hero death/KO animation, themed arena terrains/citadels and optional offline-device announcer with focus, mute and priority controls. Follow-up audit: independently controlled game SFX and voice; verified fly-to-inventory wood/gold/stone resources, level-up, loot, upgrade and construction feedback; offline tactical calls to CPU teammates; strict carry, partial-loot and wall-collision rules. Actual ranked multiplayer voice is explicitly held pending authenticated, isolated signalling infrastructure.

selectionRationale: Owner-provided landscape screenshots show overlap, clipped controls, oversized models and poor battlefield readability; the existing in-app 13-character assets and local scene plates can support a high-fidelity native HUD without a new engine, independent app or license risk. Scoped overlays and normalized editor improve usability while preserving canonical economy authority. Existing practice CPU trains/mines and does not deliver a direct no-signal fight; an isolated local hero duel reuses the same authoritative per-match combat engine rather than creating a fake animation-only demo. Existing event router reduced dozens of meaningful Arena events to six generic SFX; this work introduces semantic, priority-scored audio keyed to engine-proven events and stronger source-owned world object art. Original voice engine uses already installed expo-speech as an optional device-local announcer; no external voice API/new subscription or rank privilege. Follow-up audit found missing resource fly-to-HUD, voice tied to SFX toggle, carry overflow/partial loot loss, skill teleport through cover and no multiplayer comm transport. Fix client/offline local pathways now; preserve a fail-closed network voice release gate until secure server transport can be independently tested.
